description:
codebyEdge helps spread love by allowing you to embed a hidden message into a beautiful piece of jewellery. 

Sending A Hidden Message of Love

Morse Code - use the dots and dashes of Morse code to hide a secret message within each of our pieces of jewellery.

Types of Jewellery

  • Diamond Rings
  • Stackable Rings
  • Necklaces
  • Bracelets
  • Earrings

Our Materials

We use the highest quality metals and gems in our jewellery.

Metals

  • 925 Silver
  • 18ct Gold (Yellow or Rose Gold)
  • 950 Platinum

Diamonds

  • Cut: Premium
  • Color: D-F
  • Clarity: VVS-VS
  • Carat:
    • Dots: 0.04ct
    • Dashes: 2 x 0.08ct

All jewellery is handmade to order. All diamonds and gems are ethically sourced. 

Customise your own piece using our codebyEdge Customiser

Affiliate Marketing Program - Terms and Conditions

- Participation in our affiliate program is open to individuals, websites, bloggers, and influencers who have a relevant audience and wish to promote our jewelry.
- We reserve the right to approve or decline any application at our discretion.
- Affiliates must be at least 18 years old.

2. Affiliate Responsibilities:
- Affiliates are required to promote our jewelry in an honest and ethical manner.
- Affiliates are responsible for ensuring that their promotional activities comply with all relevant laws and regulations.

3. Commissions and Payments:
- Affiliates will earn a commission for each sale generated through their unique affiliate link.

- Commissions will not be earned on returned or canceled orders.

- Affiliates may not modify our branding or create derivative works without prior written consent.

6. Termination:
- Either party may terminate the affiliate relationship at any time for any reason.
- Violation of these terms and conditions may result in immediate termination and forfeiture of commissions.

7. Changes to Terms:
- We reserve the right to modify these terms and conditions at any time.
- Affiliates will be notified of any changes, and continued participation implies acceptance of the updated terms.

8. Liability:

9. Agreement:
- By participating in our affiliate program, you agree to these terms and conditions.

For any questions or clarifications, please contact our affiliate management team at hello (at) codebyedge.com.
